rebaseline.note: Re-baselined on PropTech AI Platform spec. Foundation features (F0xx) carried over as DONE; new platform modules (F1xx) added as roadmap M0-M5; legacy advanced stack deprecated.

foundation_reused.name: Semantic property matching (pgvector)
foundation_reused.note: KEPT as additive, free (Ollama) search layer — analyze match before validating.

foundation_reused.name: RBAC + Supabase Auth (admin/agent)
foundation_reused.note: To EXTEND to 4 levels in M4 (F140).

features.name: LLM Router (Ollama free → DeepSeek → Claude admin-only)
features.note: Free-first complexity routing; Claude hard-gated behind adminRequest (D016). Raw Messages API wire format. Endpoint secret-key protected (P008).

features.name: Secret-key Scheduler (GitHub Actions / Cron-Job.org → Edge Fn)
features.note: Secret-key dispatcher (D018) + GH Actions cron. Job registry has stubs pending M2/M3. Replaces Celery Beat.

features.name: Chat ingestion + context-preserving summarization into Supabase
features.note: Summaries run on free tier (Ollama) via router — zero Claude tokens (P006). Re-summarizes every 20 messages.

features.name: Listing-link verifier (no web crawl; verify a consulted URL is a property)
features.note: Single-URL fetch only, size/timeout capped, heuristic signals + optional free-LLM classify. D019 sanctioned exception — no crawling/search.

features.name: Context classifier/router (5 contexts)
features.note: Free-tier (Ollama) classify with heuristic fallback; persists context; resolves derive targets (wa_martillera/wa_alquileres) for tramites/inquilinos. Zero Claude tokens (P006).

features.name: Ventas/Dueños — on-demand property status reports
features.note: Owner identified by their own phone (property_owner_contacts). Real metrics: days on market, visits by status, cross-agent matches. Summarized on free tier (Ollama) — zero Claude tokens.

features.name: Compras/Interesados — advisory + visit scheduling w/ explicit advisor confirmation
features.note: Grounded advisory on free tier (Ollama). Visit requests stored as events.status='pending_advisor'; booking happens ONLY in confirm-visit on explicit advisor confirmation (P009). Reuses events table.

features.name: Trámites varios — derive to martillera personal WhatsApp
features.note: Deterministic handoff to wa_martillera; gateway performs the send. Zero cost.

features.name: Inquilinos/Arrendatarios — derive to rentals area WhatsApp
features.note: Deterministic handoff to wa_alquileres; shares the derive-context handler with F113.

features.name: Independent IA + meta-learning (free LLM) — success/failure analysis, assertive-comms tips
features.note: analyze mode (free Ollama) stores insights; digest mode is FREE by default and escalates to Claude ONLY on adminRequest (D016) — the admin-requested powerful analysis.

features.name: Incumplimiento alarms (visit/docs/report) → martillero
features.note: Detects overdue visits + stale advisor confirmations (>24h), dedups against open alarms (partial unique index), emits martillero notify. Wired to the scheduler compliance_alarms job (F101). Extensible for docs/reports.

features.name: Active interlinked-business matching (chat + pgvector additive, free)
features.note: D021 oferta↔demanda (opt1/opt2/opt3) + D022 strict scoring engine (mandatory budget±10%/zone/operation filters, affinity m²/ambientes/amenities, permuta logic). pgvector additive/free; rules authoritative. match-offers returns the agent-facing ranked recommendations with explanations.

features.name: Hidden interlink detection (discard active; notify martillero + advisors)
features.note: Same D021 offer↔demand matcher as F121 over a property sweep; keeps HIDDEN (non-active) crossings, discards actives, records link_type='hidden' candidate, emits notify (martillero + both listing advisors).

features.name: Capture documentation management (auto-request → forward to martillero for validation)
features.note: D023 escalation: bot asks the ADVISOR first; after 3 failed asks escalates to martillero for permission (authorize accept/decline); on accept the bot requests the owner; if still missing, notifies martillero to take measures. States asesor->await_martillero->bot->measures->done. receive forwards to martillero to validate.

features.name: Owner reports — programmable periods
Advisor activity reports + personalized stats tips
features.note: Advisor metrics vs team average AND vs configurable monthly goals (D024: captaciones/ventas/alquileres; defaults app_settings + per-advisor advisor_goals; admin/martillero configurable via goals fn). Reports how close/far from objective. Optional free-tier (Ollama) narrative. Zero Claude tokens.

features.name: Admin/Martillera/Marketing on-demand consolidated lists
Central calendar + weekly automated WhatsApp schedule report
features.note: Central calendar (agenda by range/agent) + weekly_report that compiles each advisor's next-7-days agenda and sends it via the gateway /send (advisor phone from whatsapp_numbers). Wired to the weekly_calendar_report scheduler job (F101). Free, no LLM.

features.name: Deals-in-process report (solo/team) with current state
features.note: Detects operations advisors are trying to close — solo vs equipo vs entrelazado — from active events, cross-agent matches and active interlinks; reports operation + current state. Optional agent_id filter. Deterministic, free.

features.name: RBAC N1 Propiedades / N2 Dueños / N3 Martillero / N4 Admin + RLS scoping
Advisor self-service: profile, weekly availability, on-demand reports

deprecated.reason: Replaced by secret-key scheduler (F101) + M3 calendar report (F133).
